data.name: Accounts.Error.Command
data.value: The account operation could not be completed safely.

data.name: Accounts.Error.Flow
data.value: The recovery step could not be advanced safely. Review the current workspace state and try again.

data.name: Accounts.State.Locked
data.value: Unlock the recovery vault to view the account inventory.

data.name: Accounts.State.Corrupted
data.value: The encrypted account inventory is incompatible or unreadable. It was not replaced.

data.name: Accounts.State.Empty
data.value: No recovery session is available for an account inventory.

data.name: Accounts.Triage.OptionalHelp
data.value: Only accounts marked Needs review require a category decision. Automatic categories are already used for recovery order and can be changed at any time.

data.name: Accounts.Triage.EmailReady
data.value: An email account was identified. You can continue recovery now or review and correct any account category.

data.name: Accounts.Triage.NoEmailReviewed
data.value: No email account was identified. Continue if this is intentional; you can return and change categories later.

data.name: Accounts.Triage.EmailRecommended
data.value: Some accounts still need review and no email account is identified yet. Check those first if one may be your email account, or continue if your inventory genuinely has none.

data.name: Accounts.Triage.NotAutomaticallyRecognized
data.value: Not automatically recognized — choose a recovery category

data.name: Accounts.Triage.Status.Message
data.value: Review accounts marked Needs review, especially if one may be your email account. Known automatic categories do not require confirmation.

data.name: Accounts.Triage.AccountHelp
data.value: Keep only enough information to recognize the account. Never enter a password, recovery code, MFA secret, or reset link.

data.name: Accounts.Triage.CategoryHelp
data.value: Automatic suggestions are used unless you change them. Unknown is only a system status for accounts unpwn could not classify; it cannot be chosen or confirmed. For an account that needs review, choose Email, Critical, or Not critical. This never decides how provider recovery works.

data.name: Accounts.Triage.CategoryRequired
data.value: Choose Email, Critical, or Not critical

data.name: Accounts.Delete.Action
data.value: Remove this account from the recovery session

data.name: Accounts.Triage.DeleteConsequence
data.value: The account and its category choice will be removed from this recovery session.

data.name: Accounts.Operation.Saved
data.value: The encrypted account inventory was updated.

data.name: Accounts.Error.Locked
data.value: Unlock the vault before changing the account inventory.

data.name: Accounts.Error.InvalidInput
data.value: Review the account fields. A provider and an account name or login are required, URLs must use HTTP or HTTPS, and an explicit category must be Email, Critical, or Not critical.

data.name: Accounts.Error.NotFound
data.value: The selected account no longer exists.

data.name: Accounts.Error.Conflict
data.value: The requested change conflicts with the current inventory.

data.name: Accounts.Error.RequiresConfirmation
data.value: Choose how duplicate accounts should be handled before continuing.

data.name: Accounts.Error.Corrupted
data.value: The encrypted inventory is incompatible or unreadable and was not overwritten.

data.name: Accounts.Error.IoFailure
data.value: The inventory could not be saved. Do not assume the change was persisted.

data.name: Import.Resolution.Required
data.value: Choose how duplicate candidates should be handled before importing.

data.name: Import.Resolution.Skip
data.value: Import first occurrence and skip later duplicates (default)

data.name: Import.Result.Success
data.value: The reviewed accounts were stored in the encrypted inventory.

data.name: Import.Result.NoChanges
data.value: No new accounts were imported because all reviewed accounts already exist in the inventory.

data.name: Import.Result.Failure
data.value: The reviewed accounts were not imported. Resolve the duplicate choice or review the inventory state.
